title: Tammy L NDE 170
content:
I'm not sure if this is a near death experience or not. However, it is very strange and I'll just let you be the judge. In 1995, I was in labor with my son. I was in my hospital room. My husband and a nurse were with me. I suddenly became very ill. I was hot and cold, and clammy all at the same time. I felt a lot of pain, though it wasn't contractions. I hurt everywhere. I became very nauseous. I felt so strange. I actually thought I was dying. I told my nurse that something was wrong. I remember her practically on top of me telling me to look at her and to breathe. I tried, but I felt so sick. I said, ‘I can't’, and then there was total darkness. Suddenly I was enveloped in a bright, white light. I felt ‘perfectness’. It was the perfect temperature. The light was bright but it was not hot on my skin like sunlight, nor did it hurt my eyes. I was very aware of the transition from pain to feeling wonderful. I felt peace, great love, joy. It seemed all my questions were answered. It's hard to describe the feeling of total utopia. I then realized that the light seemed to be shining through walls of brick glass windows. I heard laughter and looked down to see a little child smiling up at me. The little girl seemed to be about four years old. She had dark hair in a pageboy style and the most beautiful eyes I have ever seen. She didn't speak, but she seemed to convey the message that all was well and that she loved me. I was suddenly back in my hospital bed. I heard my husband asking the nurse what had happened and she said that my blood pressure had completely bottomed out. I had my son later that day and everything was fine. I began trying to find out what I had experienced. I read a book about NDE that mentioned that experiencers have sometimes seen their future children during an NDE. I found the book they referred to. There were some stories somewhat similar to mine. I have had two more sons since my experience. I have longed for the child I saw. I feel that she was meant to come to me. However, as I have a total of six sons and three daughters, my husband is unwilling. It's been seven years since I had the experience and I'm still seeking answers.

arrival.other_being_detail: A smiling little girl, about four years old, dark hair in a pageboy style; did not speak but conveyed that all was well and that she loved the experiencer.

environment.environment_other_detail: Light seemed to be shining through 'walls of brick glass windows.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Initial 'total darkness' followed by being enveloped in bright white light; saw a small child smiling; then suddenly back in hospital bed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Darkness/void transitioned directly to bright light and a child encounter; no explicit OBE or boundary described; return was sudden.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The encountered being was a small child (perceived as possibly a future child) rather than a deceased relative or guide; light described as shining through 'walls of brick glass windows.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “then there was total darkness. Suddenly I was enveloped in a bright, white light. I felt ‘perfectness’.”
